methodology.system_name: Ushna Setu Thermal Stress & Heat-Health Risk Engine

scientific_indices.name: NOAA Heat Index (HI)
scientific_indices.formula: Rothfusz Polynomial Regression: HI = c1 + c2*T + c3*RH + c4*T*RH + c5*T^2 + c6*RH^2 + c7*T^2*RH + c8*T*RH^2 + c9*T^2*RH^2 (+ low/high RH adjustments)
scientific_indices.citation: NOAA National Weather Service (NWS) Technical Attachment SR 90-23 (1990); Rothfusz (1990).
scientific_indices.role_in_ushna_setu: Provides baseline apparent temperature calibrated for sedentary human metabolic rate in shade.

scientific_indices.name: Outdoor Wet Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT)
inputs: Tw (Natural wet-bulb temperature via Stull 2011 psychrometric approximation)
Tg (Black globe temperature via Liljegren & solar radiation convective model)
scientific_indices.citation: ISO 7243:2017 (Hot environments — Estimation of heat stress on working man); Kumar et al. (2026) Indian microclimate evaluation; Liljegren et al. (2008).
scientific_indices.role_in_ushna_setu: Primary indicator for outdoor labor safety, hydration scheduling, and industrial work stoppages.

scientific_indices.name: Composite Human Thermal Stress Index (HTSI)
scientific_indices.citation: Ushna Setu core design formulation; validated against ISO 7243 ACGIH limits and IMD heatwave criteria.
scientific_indices.role_in_ushna_setu: Eliminates single-index blindspots by merging evaporative restriction, perceptual discomfort, and radiant sun load.

scientific_indices.name: Heat-Health Risk Score (0–100)
inputs: Outdoor worker density (Laborers, construction, street vendors)
Informal housing fraction (Tin/asbestos roofs, high heat retention)
scientific_indices.citation: Calibrated against dose-response epidemiological relationships from Sudharsan et al. (2025) Lancet Planetary Health India heatwave study, Kacker et al. (2025/2026), and Banerjee et al. (2024).
scientific_indices.role_in_ushna_setu: Direct proxy for ward-level hospital emergency surge and acute heat-stroke vulnerability, driving targeted municipal intervention.

ml_forecast_layer.bias_correction: Supervised calibration to adjust gridded regional NWP models against localized urban heat island (UHI) signatures.
